newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude price down to $21.35 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude price down to $21.35 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude fell to an average of $21.35 per barrel on October 9 from $21.37 the day before, a spokesman for state-run Petroecuador said Tuesday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The average price in September was $20.03 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
